analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – addresses a common problem (finding pickup games) and offers a consolidated solution. Potential is significant but needs validation beyond initial interviews.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• The MVP-then-iterate approach is sensible.
